### What each command is doing
1. **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**
   - Runs module-level experiments from the module registry.
   - Promotes the best-performing candidate (if any) relative to the current champion criteria.

2. **`system_autopilot.py ... --run`**
   - Runs system-level candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.
   - Useful when improvements come from interactions across modules, not isolated module swaps.

3. **`aub_next_fix.py ... next_fix.md`**
   - Generates a prioritized “what to fix next” report based on registry + recent results.
   - This is the artifact you’ll typically consult if no candidates are passing.
